Forms are removed when remove_forms is true

```kotlin title="Kotlin (Android)"
import io.xberg.android.*
import com.fasterxml.jackson.module.kotlin.jacksonObjectMapper

fun main() {
    val mapper = jacksonObjectMapper()
    val options = mapper.readValue("{\"preprocessing\":{\"remove_forms\":true}}", ConversionOptions::class.java)
    val result = HtmlToMarkdown.convert("<p>Before</p><form><input type='text'/><button>Submit</button></form><p>After</p>", options)
    println(result)
}
```
